label: Table 3.5
caption: Table 3.5 Summary of minimum requirements for sanitary provision in typical dwelling types (dwellings should also comply with relevant detailed requirements set out in paragraphs 3.36-3.43) Single storey dwelling (typically a flat or bungalow)
description:
The image shows a two-column ruled table with a thin black outer border, horizontal rules between rows, no vertical rule separating the two columns, and no ticks, crosses, filled or empty circles, or drawings. The top pale-green shaded band contains the title, set in bold black words: “Table 3.5 Summary of minimum requirements for sanitary provision in typical dwelling types (dwellings should also comply with relevant detailed requirements set out in paragraphs 3.36-3.43)”. Immediately below the title is a separate pale-green shaded band, in green letters, reading “Single storey dwelling (typically a flat or bungalow)”. The green shading is used to distinguish the title and the two dwelling-type section headings from the table body.

Beneath the first shaded section band, the two column headings are underlined, in green letters: “Occupancy” in the left column and “Typical minimum sanitary provision” in the right column. The first row has “2 or 3 bedspaces” in the left column and “Bathroom with level access shower” in the right column. The second row has “4 bedspaces” and “Bathroom with level access shower and separate WC/cloakroom”. The third row has “5 bedspaces or more” and “Bathroom with level access shower and separate WC/cloakroom (or second bathroom). Wheelchair accessible dwellings must also provide both a level access shower and a bath”, with “Wheelchair accessible” in green italic.

A second pale-green shaded band, in green letters, reads “Two or three storey dwelling (typically a house or maisonette)”, and the same underlined column headings, “Occupancy” and “Typical minimum sanitary provision”, are repeated below it. The first row of this section has “2 or 3 bedspaces” and “Bathroom with level access shower on same level as principal bedroom + entrance storey WC/cloakroom (where bathroom not on the entrance storey)”. The character after “principal bedroom” is a plus sign. The phrase “entrance storey WC/cloakroom” after the plus sign is printed in green; the later words “entrance storey” in the parentheses are not green. The second row has “4 bedspaces” and “Bathroom with level access shower on same level as principal bedroom and entrance storey WC/cloakroom or second bathroom”, with “entrance storey WC/cloakroom” in green. The third row has “5 bedspaces or more” and “Bathroom with level access shower on same level as principal bedroom and entrance storey WC/cloakroom or second bathroom. Wheelchair accessible dwellings must also provide both a level access shower and a bath”, with “entrance storey WC/cloakroom” in green and “Wheelchair accessible” in green italic. The data cells have a white background.
